kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON:
{"query":{"query":"source = logs-otel-v1*
| where `resource.attributes.service.name` in $service
| where severityNumber >= $min_severity
| stats count() as logs by span(`@timestamp`, 30m) as time_bucket, `resource.attributes.service.name`
| sort time_bucket","language":"PPL","dataset":{"id":"85c9f700-905d-11f1-8e13-1fc52a695474","title":"logs-otel-v1*","type":"INDEX_PATTERN","timeFieldName":"time"}},"filter":[],"indexRefName":"kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON.index"}

{"query":{"query":"source = logs-otel-v1*
| where `resource.attributes.service.name` in $service
| where severityNumber >= $min_severity
| stats sum(case(severityNumber >= 17, 1 else 0)) as errors, sum(case(severityNumber >= 9 AND severityNumber < 17, 1 else 0)) as info, sum(case(severityNumber < 9, 1 else 0)) as unspecified by `resource.attributes.service.name`
| sort `resource.attributes.service.name`","language":"PPL","dataset":{"id":"85c9f700-905d-11f1-8e13-1fc52a695474","title":"logs-otel-v1*","type":"INDEX_PATTERN","timeFieldName":"time"}},"filter":[],"indexRefName":"kibanaSavedObjectMeta.searchSourceJSON.index"}
